scenes.summary: The South and North arrays have been completed. Zhuang Fangyi thanks you on behalf of the entirety of Wuling. The next step is to make a sizable batch of Lucidolite Energy Bricks for array ignition and activation.

lines.text: Today marks our first step in rebuilding the North Wuling EZ. Two new Tianshi Pillar Arrays for suppressing the branch rifts have been completed.
Such progress is only made possible through the hard work of our Tianshi. On behalf of Wuling, I offer you my sincere gratitude.
We owe it to the Endmin. Without all those supplies produced by the AIC, none of this would be possible.
Very true. This project also proves the united solidarity of the Civilization Band.
Tianshi Zhuang, you mentioned that I'd witness a new beginning for Wuling. Is it coming soon?
Very soon. But let me put it slightly differently. This isn't just a new beginning, but also a valuable legacy from the past.
Yeah. Tianshi Liu and his peers drafted the designs for the new array. With them we fashioned a bright future ahead of us!
Since everyone knows by now, I'll have to say yes... But we should let the young generation decide the future, no?
Tianshi Hong, you demonstrated good judgment, commitment, and team work throughout the project. You proved your ability to lead it.
Oh, thank you, Tianshi Zhuang, but ... I don't think I'm really ready for this...
No one's ever perfectly ready for anything. When I was your age, my old man had to force me to be a proper Tianshi.
But I hardly did anything. Everyone helped with the heavy lifting...
What happened, Hong? You were bossing around, looking all proud and haughty before. Are you scared of actual leadership?
Sheesh, fine. I'll take it! Much as I want the annoying press interviews to end, it still beats getting nagged at by an old codger.
If you want fame, you gotta have thicker skin. Don't just push your own people around. Watch and learn from the Endmin, Hong.
I will. Once this entire project is over, just mention my name in an interview. That'll be the positive coverage I need.
And you are welcome to call me, for urgent advice.
Alright! Now, we just need to do one last thing to ignite this new array!
To keep this array running, you'll need a huge and stable supply of components and matching energy bricks. Do you have them all?
You listed everything in your plan, Mr. Liu. And I've already prepped it all. The Endfield Research Division just sent us the blueprints.
Really? That sounds good ... very good...

scenes.summary: Just before array activation, the branch rifts suddenly become unstable and no one could contact Tianshi Liu. Zhuang Fangyi initiates a backup plan for an early ignition. Though Tianshi Hong is worried, she keeps her calm and ignites the South Array under your protection.

lines.text: I know what to do. Go on ahead. I'll issue the ignition command once everything is ready.
Endmin, we've finally made it to this stage. The branch rifts are no longer a threat. We can now start rebuilding this land.
How are you feeling right now? I guess it's a ... very emotional moment.
It is quite emotional. Though the project has progressed smoothly, reaching this place has been quite a tumultuous journey.
Endmin, if you weren't here to help, this day wouldn't have come so soon. But now we can show you a Wuling worthy of its legacy, one that is built for posterity.
Endmin!
Endmin, we're about to go! Wait. Am I interrupting something serious?
You're not. We just finished talking. We'll pick things up after the ignition — Is everything set, Tianshi Hong?
Yeah. Sorry for being a little late. It's just like what Mr. Liu said, this site is hazardous and we need to prepare for it...
Tianshi Hong, you're being more careful now.
Haha. I can't make my mentor annoyed all the time. You actually helped me learn more about him as well.
I'm doing this not just to prove myself, but to live up to our duties and a great legacy — left to us by Mr. Liu and his late peers...
Zip your trap, Hong. I'm still very much alive and well!
Ah! Mr. Liu! I'm so sorry, that's really not what I meant!
I stayed on the line because I thought you were doing the final checks. Then you started burdo-mucking the Endmin with that foolery.
Are you done with the checks? I'm at the North Array but I need to handle something. You can —
Mr. Liu? What's happening on your end? The connection's just got really bad!
Blightshades... It's them again! I think I got too —
Mr. Liu! Sir...! We lost the connection!
Fangyi, we just picked up a sudden spike of instability of the branch rifts. Æther energy is spreading from a site near the North Array.
There is no need to panic. We have planned for such incidents and this one is still within threshold.
We'll follow our contingency plan and go for an early ignition. Tianshi Hong, I'll need you at the South Array ASAP!
No problem, but...
Don't worry. The Yinglungs have been deployed. Tianshi Ge already told Tianshi Liu of this plan. He'll be alright.
We must respond to this quickly. I shall go on ahead and lead the way. Endmin, please escort Tianshi Hong to the South Array for the ignition.
Understood. Tianshi Hong, let's go!
Mm...! Let's do this!

scenes.summary: Both the South and North arrays have been ignited but Tianshi Liu remains to be found. Meanwhile, you find the old Tianshi has left a letter for his disciple, Tianshi Hong.

lines.text: South Array ignition success!
North Array ignition success!
Comms are back online, everyone. We did it!
Huh? It's you guys?
Well, Tianshi Liu left for some urgent business. He isn't back yet.
It looked as though ... he saw something familiar...
So where's my mentor right now?
Tianshi Ge is still trying to contact him. Don't worry.
Endmin, what are you looking at?
Tianshi Liu left this for you.
Mr. Liu ... left me a letter?

scenes.summary: New arrays for the North Wuling Exclusion Zone have been completed. Tianshi Liu and Tianshi Hong start brainstorming about the future. You promise Zhuang Fangyi that you will continue to support the rebuilding project.

lines.text: In any case, thank you both for your hard work on the construction of the North Wuling EZ Array. I hope we can continue to count on your support in the subsequent rebuilding efforts.
Tianshi Zhuang, don't worry and leave the work to us!
Don't get ahead of yourself. I'm still the reviewer of your work. If you mess up, I'll have no choice but to retire!
Rest assured, Mr. Liu. I've got stricter standards than you. In fact, I'm gonna overhaul the entire Tianshi Pillar tech. So don't fall behind!
Hmph. Strong words, Hong. Now that you've said it, this array deserves plenty of improvements. But ... I think we should keep things safe...
Endministrator, our Tianshi are planning for the future again.
If I have the time, I'll swing by and give them a hand.
Endmin, come take a look at our construction progress!
Mr. Liu? Old man refuses to rest. Whenever he's done his work, he would start loitering around my place. I asked what he was doing and he always said he's just taking a stroll after lunch...
He's a bad liar. No one has lunch five times a day. He was probably trying to nitpick again. He also started jogging recently. Maybe he'll end up with better cardio than me...
Should I start exercising again and get back in form? But ... my schedule's so packed. Maybe I should wait till I have some leave...

The biggest challenges have already been dealt with. We just have to keep things running, strengthen the weakpoints, and keep testing. There'll be tons of iterations. Troublesome, but that's where the fun is.
And, Endmin, I'd like to thank you once again. For years we drew our designs and visions, but it was your assistance that made them a reality.
Of course, one should always aim higher. Mr. Liu can't have all the fun nagging. I think it's my turn to do a little nitpicking with the younger Tianshi now. Heheh.
Endmin, we need tons of supplies to keep the arrays running. Feel free to check on our progress!
Totally! And you're welcome to visit anytime!
Mr. Liu...

scenes.summary: Tianshi Liu finally appears and he seems unhurt. The false panic ends and everything settles down. While the Old Tianshi argues with his disciple, you and Zhuang Fangyi begin envisioning the future for Wuling and Talos-II.

lines.text: I guess he left it here so that Tianshi Hong can read it after the ignition...
This is ... the only exception that I did not expect...
I know... I understand everything he said, but ... why...?
Tianshi Liu ... he must have experienced something that compelled him to write this letter.
We should stop speculating and let the Tianshi himself explain.
What are you doing?
Wha?!
The ignition went well. Why are you looking so defeated?
Oh, you're... I... Mr. Liu, thank goodness you're alright!
Why are you worried? We already planned for this... I was on a routine check deeper in the site. Something came up, comms went out, and I missed the ignition.
I kept telling Hong to watch out for the unexpected. Never thought it'd happen to me, and all I could do was listen to the Yinglungs. Ah yeah, I saw the successful ignition, so I came over to look.
So what about ... the letter...?
Oh... I wrote that a long time ago. I was planning to retire and wanted to encourage my disciples. But I forgot where I left my draft. Someone else found it, I guess.
Your letter wasn't encouraging at all! It reads like a will! And don't you quit on me, Mr. Liu! I got plenty of achievements queued up to prove to you!
Prove? You don't have to do that. You completed Tianshi Zhuang's assignment and earned the Endmin's approval. You don't have to prove anything to this old man.
I gotta prove your nagging is just annoying! I'm way more meticulous than you. For starters, I won't leave important letters lying around!
Is this really something you didn't expect?
The contents of the letter have indeed surprised me. I never realized Tianshi Liu was thinking about all that... But I guess he won't be retiring any time soon, right?
From Valley IV to Wuling, we've met quite a few people who kept us busy... But it's friends like them who made today possible.
It's just maintenance. Why are you bothering the escort crew? I trained that safety officer over there. I'm more qualified than he is.
Of course, senior Tianshi Mr. Liu. I know you're very experienced! But please stop doing things on your own.
Indeed. From Project Xiranite to this day, Wuling has come a long way. Our long-held wish ... has finally been fulfilled.
As we continue to walk with you, we will definitely usher in a new future for Talos-II.
